name: zapier-demo
title_zh: 当场跑通第一个 Zapier 动作的带路向导
tagline_zh: 别再看文档了。它问你用什么应用，挑一个只读动作，引你去 mcp.zapier.com 授权。
tagline_en: Skip the docs. It asks your app, picks one read action, walks you to mcp.zapier.com to enable it, then runs it.
desc_en: Walk a new user through setting up their first Zapier action and running it live — the smallest possible win. Asks what app they use, recommends one read action to enable, guides them to mcp.zapier.com to add it, then demonstrates it working in the same chat. Use when the user asks "show me how Zapier works", "set up my first action", "give me a quick demo", "I want to try it", "what's the fastest
why_zh: 把「设置→授权→验证」压成一条对话流，每一步都停在你能确认的地方。不是讲原理，是陪你做完第一件真事。
why_en: Compresses setup→auth→verify into one conversational flow, pausing at each checkpoint you can confirm. It doesn't explain—it.
limit_zh: 只覆盖 Zapier 的首次引导：一个只读动作、一个应用。不处理多步 Zap、筛选、格式化或错误重试。
limit_en: Only first-run onboarding: one read action, one app. No multi-step Zaps, filters, formatting, or retries. If the action fails post-auth, it points.
title_en: Live guide to your first working Zapier action
